Initial release of vocational-course-material-development skill.

- Provides a comprehensive methodology for integrated development of vocational education courses and teaching materials.
- Utilizes job competency maps and AI-empowered processes to guide systematic content creation, review, and optimization.
- Includes a closed-loop development path from job competency mapping to modular content reconstruction and course mapping.
- Emphasizes adaptability, consistency, systematicity, and supportiveness in vocational education material design.
- Aligns with the latest vocational education reform policy requirements (2026, China Ministry of Education).
